rationale: Parent baseline 0.9672 with only summary_quality=0.934 non-perfect; max remaining headroom 0.033. Frontier (Round 4, +0.0016) already captured the one safe content lever (conciseness parenthetical in section_summary.md). The three other summary_quality sub-criteria (accuracy, completeness, faithfulness) each have a direct precedent failure: Round 1 (−0.025, completeness coverage push → 32k truncation on 2 rows) and Round 6 (−0.105, faithfulness no-add bullet → 2 rows to invalid JSON). Sampling is exhausted (Round 3 T=0.0 was effective noop; top_p narrowing or lowering max_tokens from 32000 add no deterministic signal and risk truncation). Adding a new runtime rule listing the four judge sub-criteria is semantically equivalent to concatenating Round 1 + Round 6 and would likely reproduce their truncation cascade. Edits to hierarchy / citations / exclusions / output_schema / identity either touch judges already at 1.0 (schema_adherence, output_json_valid) or destabilize scaffold components whose per-example effect we cannot observe — the baseline failure list provides no per-sub-criterion breakdown and no model outputs. Risk/reward is deeply asymmetric: the only kept content edit was +0.0016, while the two reverts were −0.025 and −0.105 (combined mean −0.065, 40× the mean kept gain). Noop preserves the Round-4 frontier (0.9688), eliminates the chance of another catastrophic revert this cycle, and lets the next round proceed from a clean parent. The prompt contract explicitly endorses this: 'noop with a thoughtful rationale is preferable to a risky guess.'
